lore11096_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere affection, delighted, welcoming] Someone who notices the details and stays for the company. I like you very much. Shall we go and enjoy the day?
lore11096_befriended_1.ogg.text: Someone who notices the details and stays for the company. I like you very much. Shall we go and enjoy the day?

lore11096_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [bright confidence, playful vanity, friendly] There you are. An outing? Splendid. I chose rather well today, if I do say so. We should give the outfit a little daylight.
lore11096_greet_1.ogg.text: There you are. An outing? Splendid. I chose rather well today, if I do say so. We should give the outfit a little daylight.

lore11096_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [confiding, amused, pleased with himself] The pocket lining is for me. A little flourish nobody has to approve of. Yes, even I sometimes dress without an audience.
lore11096_idle_1.ogg.text: The pocket lining is for me. A little flourish nobody has to approve of. Yes, even I sometimes dress without an audience.

lore11096_learned_1.ogg.spoken: [enthusiastic, encouraging, curious] A new technique! Excellent. Now you can make it look as good as it works. Show me when you've had a little practice.
lore11096_learned_1.ogg.text: A new technique! Excellent. Now you can make it look as good as it works. Show me when you've had a little practice.

lore11867_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere warmth, welcoming, quietly pleased] A friend, then. Good. You needn't prove anything to enjoy my company. Let us see what the day brings.
lore11867_befriended_1.ogg.text: A friend, then. Good. You needn't prove anything to enjoy my company. Let us see what the day brings.

lore11867_combatEnd_1.ogg.spoken: [calm authority, reassuring, focused] Steady. Is everyone all right? Good. Remember what worked, and what you will do differently next time.
lore11867_combatEnd_1.ogg.text: Steady. Is everyone all right? Good. Remember what worked, and what you will do differently next time.

lore11867_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [confident, composed, lightly amused] Ready? Good. An ordinary walk can be an excellent change of pace. You may put the weapon away.
lore11867_greet_1.ogg.text: Ready? Good. An ordinary walk can be an excellent change of pace. You may put the weapon away.

lore11867_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [matter-of-fact, dry humor, warm respect] Yes, I thank the practice dummy. It is always ready, never complains, and has endured a remarkable number of beginners.
lore11867_idle_1.ogg.text: Yes, I thank the practice dummy. It is always ready, never complains, and has endured a remarkable number of beginners.

lore1212_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [gentle affection, sincere pleasure, welcoming] You came to bring me along. I am pleased, my friend. Come. We need not begin with a difficult question. Your company is welcome for its own sake.
lore1212_befriended_1.ogg.text: You came to bring me along. I am pleased, my friend. Come. We need not begin with a difficult question. Your company is welcome for its own sake.

lore1212_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [calm hospitality, reflective, gently interested] Good to see you, my friend. Have you come far? We can take our time. Tell me what has occupied your thoughts, or simply what you noticed on the way.
lore1212_greet_1.ogg.text: Good to see you, my friend. Have you come far? We can take our time. Tell me what has occupied your thoughts, or simply what you noticed on the way.

lore1212_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [thoughtful amusement, unhurried, confiding] My reading list continues to grow. Then I take down a familiar book and read the same chapter again. I enjoy it. That seems a sufficient use of a quiet hour.
lore1212_idle_1.ogg.text: My reading list continues to grow. Then I take down a familiar book and read the same chapter again. I enjoy it. That seems a sufficient use of a quiet hour.

lore1212_rest_1.ogg.spoken: [soothing, patient hospitality, unhurried] A little rest would be wise. Sit a moment. You can tell me what has been troubling you, or we can simply enjoy a quiet pause together.
lore1212_rest_1.ogg.text: A little rest would be wise. Sit a moment. You can tell me what has been troubling you, or we can simply enjoy a quiet pause together.

lore12336_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [reserved affection, dignified, warmly inviting] You came to bring me along. Very well, my friend. I shall be glad of your company. Tell me how you have been; there is time for more than the formal report.
lore12336_befriended_1.ogg.text: You came to bring me along. Very well, my friend. I shall be glad of your company. Tell me how you have been; there is time for more than the formal report.

lore12336_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [formal warmth, firm measured delivery, interested] There you are, my friend. Have you news of the road? Come, we can walk while you tell me. And do include the details you thought too small to mention.
lore12336_greet_1.ogg.text: There you are, my friend. Have you news of the road? Come, we can walk while you tell me. And do include the details you thought too small to mention.

lore12336_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [dry restrained humor, precise, privately amused] I leave space for my signature. Then I add a question, and a detail I had nearly forgotten. By the time the letter is finished, the signature has been driven into a corner. Again.
lore12336_idle_1.ogg.text: I leave space for my signature. Then I add a question, and a detail I had nearly forgotten. By the time the letter is finished, the signature has been driven into a corner. Again.

lore12336_mail_1.ogg.spoken: [attentive, reflective warmth, deliberate] A letter? Read it through. Even the lines added at the end may be worth your time. Someone remembered another thing they wanted you to know.
lore12336_mail_1.ogg.text: A letter? Read it through. Even the lines added at the end may be worth your time. Someone remembered another thing they wanted you to know.

lore12480_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [restrained affection, pleased, warmly inviting] You came to bring me along. I am pleased, mate. Come on. We can have a little of the day without sending one another anywhere.
lore12480_befriended_1.ogg.text: You came to bring me along. I am pleased, mate. Come on. We can have a little of the day without sending one another anywhere.

lore12480_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [brisk authority, good-humored warmth, welcoming] There you are, mate. Come along. That is an invitation, before you ask. A little walk would be welcome, and you can tell me what has kept you busy.
lore12480_greet_1.ogg.text: There you are, mate. Come along. That is an invitation, before you ask. A little walk would be welcome, and you can tell me what has kept you busy.

lore12480_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [dry self-mockery, slightly embarrassed, conversational] I asked for one loaf. Quietly, I thought. Sounded like I wanted the whole bakery to form up. Next time I shall begin with please, and address only the person behind the counter.
lore12480_idle_1.ogg.text: I asked for one loaf. Quietly, I thought. Sounded like I wanted the whole bakery to form up. Next time I shall begin with please, and address only the person behind the counter.

lore12480_quest_1.ogg.spoken: [brisk approval, practical advice, encouraging] Good work. When you report back, give them the useful part first. They will want to know what happened, and whether the work is done.
lore12480_quest_1.ogg.text: Good work. When you report back, give them the useful part first. They will want to know what happened, and whether the work is done.

lore1257_bagsFull_1.ogg.spoken: [calm, practical voice, gently firm] We need a little space around the glass. Trust me on this.
lore1257_bagsFull_1.ogg.text: We need a little space around the glass. Trust me on this.

lore1257_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [warm, slightly bashful voice, sincere gratitude] You stayed for the whole tune. That means more than you might think.
lore1257_befriended_1.ogg.text: You stayed for the whole tune. That means more than you might think.

lore1257_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [genial, attentive voice, mild concern] Ready to go? One moment. I can hear something loose in that pack.
lore1257_greet_1.ogg.text: Ready to go? One moment. I can hear something loose in that pack.

lore1257_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [quiet, amused voice, appreciative wonder] That bottle has a lovely note. Shame it's full of something expensive.
lore1257_idle_1.ogg.text: That bottle has a lovely note. Shame it's full of something expensive.

lore1284_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [reserved sincere affection, calm hospitality, inviting] You came for my company. I am pleased, my friend. Let us walk a little. There is time to hear what is on your mind and to give it proper attention.
lore1284_befriended_1.ogg.text: You came for my company. I am pleased, my friend. Let us walk a little. There is time to hear what is on your mind and to give it proper attention.

lore1284_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [measured dignified warmth, reflective interest, welcoming] A little time together? Gladly. Come, tell me what has occupied your attention. I was considering something quite ordinary, and finding that it had held my interest longer than I intended.
lore1284_greet_1.ogg.text: A little time together? Gladly. Come, tell me what has occupied your attention. I was considering something quite ordinary, and finding that it had held my interest longer than I intended.

lore1284_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [quiet private amusement, thoughtful, unhurried] A plain bead of glass can send a bright fleck traveling over the desk. I have followed it with a finger, then discovered I had lost my place in a much more serious book. An undemanding little diversion.
lore1284_idle_1.ogg.text: A plain bead of glass can send a bright fleck traveling over the desk. I have followed it with a finger, then discovered I had lost my place in a much more serious book. An undemanding little diversion.

lore1284_loot_1.ogg.spoken: [grave careful instruction, observant, deliberate] Give it a proper look. A bright surface can be pleasing without telling you everything you need to know. If something about it troubles you, attend to that before putting it to use.
lore1284_loot_1.ogg.text: Give it a proper look. A bright surface can be pleasing without telling you everything you need to know. If something about it troubles you, attend to that before putting it to use.

lore1285_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere affection, quietly delighted, inviting] You came to bring me along. I am pleased, my friend. Come on. We can enjoy the walk, and you can give me your thoughts about the wall.
lore1285_befriended_1.ogg.text: You came to bring me along. I am pleased, my friend. Come on. We can enjoy the walk, and you can give me your thoughts about the wall.

lore1285_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [warm welcome, restrained excitement, playful pride] Ah, my friend. Shall we take a walk? I have improved the drawbridge. The wall still needs attention, but the opening is very satisfying. You must come and inspect it sometime.
lore1285_greet_1.ogg.text: Ah, my friend. Shall we take a walk? I have improved the drawbridge. The wall still needs attention, but the opening is very satisfying. You must come and inspect it sometime.

lore1285_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [dry amusement, fond enthusiasm, confiding] The drawbridge opens beautifully. Then the wall falls over. A small weakness in the defenses, I admit. But I should hate to lose that opening. You would understand if you saw it.
lore1285_idle_1.ogg.text: The drawbridge opens beautifully. Then the wall falls over. A small weakness in the defenses, I admit. But I should hate to lose that opening. You would understand if you saw it.

lore1285_loot_1.ogg.spoken: [interested curiosity, warm encouragement, thoughtful] Something useful? Have a proper look. An ordinary thing can hold a very good idea, if you give it a little thought before putting it aside.
lore1285_loot_1.ogg.text: Something useful? Have a proper look. An ordinary thing can hold a very good idea, if you give it a little thought before putting it aside.

lore1289_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere affection, relaxed, warmly pleased] Someone to see beyond the counter. That's welcome. Come along, my friend. We've time for a proper conversation.
lore1289_befriended_1.ogg.text: Someone to see beyond the counter. That's welcome. Come along, my friend. We've time for a proper conversation.

lore1289_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [steady, welcoming, easygoing] Good to see you. A walk before the next cup? Certainly. The racks can look after themselves for a little while.
lore1289_greet_1.ogg.text: Good to see you. A walk before the next cup? Certainly. The racks can look after themselves for a little while.

lore1289_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [fond, practical, mildly amused] The teapot? It's a good teapot. The dents don't stop it working, and a little polish makes a break feel civilized.
lore1289_idle_1.ogg.text: The teapot? It's a good teapot. The dents don't stop it working, and a little polish makes a break feel civilized.

lore1289_rest_1.ogg.spoken: [contented, unhurried, companionable] Let's sit. If we were back at the shop, this would be the moment for a cup. No need to hurry the break.
lore1289_rest_1.ogg.text: Let's sit. If we were back at the shop, this would be the moment for a cup. No need to hurry the break.

lore1294_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere warmth, cheerful welcome] Good company and an honest opinion. I'm pleased to have both in the same friend. Come along, then.
lore1294_befriended_1.ogg.text: Good company and an honest opinion. I'm pleased to have both in the same friend. Come along, then.

lore1294_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [hearty, practical, friendly] A walk? Certainly. A chance to move around instead of telling everyone else to do it. Good idea.
lore1294_greet_1.ogg.text: A walk? Certainly. A chance to move around instead of telling everyone else to do it. Good idea.

lore1294_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [hopeful pride, self-deprecating humor, warm] The biscuits are improving. This batch needs less tea. Well, a little less. The important thing is that I'm still trying.
lore1294_idle_1.ogg.text: The biscuits are improving. This batch needs less tea. Well, a little less. The important thing is that I'm still trying.

lore1294_rest_1.ogg.spoken: [jovial, teasing, affectionately candid] A seat would be welcome. If I offer you a biscuit later, remember how honestly we've always spoken to one another.
lore1294_rest_1.ogg.text: A seat would be welcome. If I offer you a biscuit later, remember how honestly we've always spoken to one another.

lore1298_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere warmth, pleased, gently teasing] You came back for the company. Well, I am pleased. Come along, my friend. You have earned the very worst of my jokes.
lore1298_befriended_1.ogg.text: You came back for the company. Well, I am pleased. Come along, my friend. You have earned the very worst of my jokes.

lore1298_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [genial, playful salesman confidence, warmly welcoming] Ah, a familiar face! Shall we go out? I have been saving a particularly dreadful joke, and I could use a fresh audience.
lore1298_greet_1.ogg.text: Ah, a familiar face! Shall we go out? I have been saving a particularly dreadful joke, and I could use a fresh audience.

lore1298_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [conspiratorial, self-deprecating amusement, cheerful] I keep the good jokes on scraps of wrapping paper. The dreadful ones too. Rather more of those, if I am honest.
lore1298_idle_1.ogg.text: I keep the good jokes on scraps of wrapping paper. The dreadful ones too. Rather more of those, if I am honest.

lore1298_loot_1.ogg.spoken: [pleased, lightly mischievous, friendly] A good find! Now, are you keeping it, selling it, or waiting for me to make a terrible remark about it?
lore1298_loot_1.ogg.text: A good find! Now, are you keeping it, selling it, or waiting for me to make a terrible remark about it?

lore1300_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere warmth, companionable, reassuring] It's good to have a friend who'll remind me when I'm being stubborn. I hope you'll let me do the same for you.
lore1300_befriended_1.ogg.text: It's good to have a friend who'll remind me when I'm being stubborn. I hope you'll let me do the same for you.

lore1300_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [patient, dryly amused, friendly] An outing would be welcome. I've been advising people to take a break all morning. Time I followed my own advice.
lore1300_greet_1.ogg.text: An outing would be welcome. I've been advising people to take a break all morning. Time I followed my own advice.

lore1300_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [self-deprecating, gentle humor, candid] Yes, I knot my own thread. Then I have to listen to my own advice about patience. Most inconvenient.
lore1300_idle_1.ogg.text: Yes, I knot my own thread. Then I have to listen to my own advice about patience. Most inconvenient.

lore1300_learned_1.ogg.spoken: [quiet pride, encouraging, warmly approving] There you are. You couldn't do that before, and now you can. Give yourself credit for the practice.
lore1300_learned_1.ogg.text: There you are. You couldn't do that before, and now you can. Give yourself credit for the practice.

lore1308_bagsFull_1.ogg.spoken: [practical concern, kindly advice, lightly amused] Have a look through before setting out again. The little thing you actually need is easily forgotten among all the things you thought you might.
lore1308_bagsFull_1.ogg.text: Have a look through before setting out again. The little thing you actually need is easily forgotten among all the things you thought you might.

lore1308_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere affection, quietly delighted, inviting] You came to bring me along. I am glad, my friend. Come on. We can have a pleasant walk and consider what might go into supper.
lore1308_befriended_1.ogg.text: You came to bring me along. I am glad, my friend. Come on. We can have a pleasant walk and consider what might go into supper.

lore1308_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [practical warmth, gentle amusement, welcoming] Ah, my friend. Have you what you need for the road? Good. Then let us have a walk. You may help me remember what went into that soup, though I fear the evidence is gone.
lore1308_greet_1.ogg.text: Ah, my friend. Have you what you need for the road? Good. Then let us have a walk. You may help me remember what went into that soup, though I fear the evidence is gone.

lore1308_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [dry humor, sheepishly pleased, conversational] The soup was excellent. I remember that much. What went into it? Something that needed using, then something else. This is why I cannot offer a reliable recipe.
lore1308_idle_1.ogg.text: The soup was excellent. I remember that much. What went into it? Something that needed using, then something else. This is why I cannot offer a reliable recipe.

lore1310_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [warm, quietly pleased, easygoing] Someone to talk to who isn't asking whether the hat comes in another color. Splendid. I'm glad you came.
lore1310_befriended_1.ogg.text: Someone to talk to who isn't asking whether the hat comes in another color. Splendid. I'm glad you came.

lore1310_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [dry humor, friendly, unhurried] A walk? Certainly. Let's hope the wind has better manners today. I've spent enough time chasing hats.
lore1310_greet_1.ogg.text: A walk? Certainly. Let's hope the wind has better manners today. I've spent enough time chasing hats.

lore1310_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [fond, mildly defensive, amused] It's an old hat. A very comfortable old hat. I sell new ones; that doesn't oblige me to stop liking this one.
lore1310_idle_1.ogg.text: It's an old hat. A very comfortable old hat. I sell new ones; that doesn't oblige me to stop liking this one.

lore1310_taxi_1.ogg.spoken: [alarmed, comic urgency, raised voice] Hold on to your hat! Yes, even the expensive one. Especially the expensive one!
lore1310_taxi_1.ogg.text: Hold on to your hat! Yes, even the expensive one. Especially the expensive one!

lore1315_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere affection, quietly pleased, inviting] You came to bring me along. I am pleased, my friend. Come on. It will be good to have a little of the day together.
lore1315_befriended_1.ogg.text: You came to bring me along. I am pleased, my friend. Come on. It will be good to have a little of the day together.

lore1315_gear_1.ogg.spoken: [interested appreciation, warm encouragement] Have a proper look at the workmanship. Someone gave their time and care to that. I hope it serves you well.
lore1315_gear_1.ogg.text: Have a proper look at the workmanship. Someone gave their time and care to that. I hope it serves you well.

lore1315_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [gentle warmth, playful anticipation, welcoming] Ah, there you are. Shall we take a walk? If we find a plain wall and a good light, I may show you a dragon. You may need to be generous about the wings.
lore1315_greet_1.ogg.text: Ah, there you are. Shall we take a walk? If we find a plain wall and a good light, I may show you a dragon. You may need to be generous about the wings.

lore1315_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [self-mocking amusement, hopeful, confiding] The dragon keeps acquiring rabbit ears. I could call it a rare breed, I suppose. But I would rather get the wings right. You will tell me honestly, won't you?
lore1315_idle_1.ogg.text: The dragon keeps acquiring rabbit ears. I could call it a rare breed, I suppose. But I would rather get the wings right. You will tell me honestly, won't you?

lore1319_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere affection, pleased, inviting] You came to bring me along. I am glad, my friend. Come on. A walk with someone willing to share the experiment sounds good to me.
lore1319_befriended_1.ogg.text: You came to bring me along. I am glad, my friend. Come on. A walk with someone willing to share the experiment sounds good to me.

lore1319_gear_1.ogg.spoken: [practical interest, firm advice, encouraging] Take a proper look at how it is made and how it suits you. A confident description is useful only if the gear earns it.
lore1319_gear_1.ogg.text: Take a proper look at how it is made and how it suits you. A confident description is useful only if the gear earns it.

lore1319_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [practical warmth, dry amusement, hopeful] There you are, my friend. Have you time for a walk? I have made another adjustment to the kite. A shield-shaped kite, yes. You may admire the ambition while we wait for the results.
lore1319_greet_1.ogg.text: There you are, my friend. Have you time for a walk? I have made another adjustment to the kite. A shield-shaped kite, yes. You may admire the ambition while we wait for the results.

lore1319_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [wry self-awareness, pleased anticipation, confiding] I have chosen the colors for the tail. A splendid tail. Getting the rest of the kite to stay up comes first, I suppose. Still, it helps to have something cheerful to imagine while I make another adjustment.
lore1319_idle_1.ogg.text: I have chosen the colors for the tail. A splendid tail. Getting the rest of the kite to stay up comes first, I suppose. Still, it helps to have something cheerful to imagine while I make another adjustment.

lore1320_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere affection, quietly pleased, inviting] You came to bring me along. I am glad, my friend. Come on. Let us find somewhere to enjoy a little time without a counter between us.
lore1320_befriended_1.ogg.text: You came to bring me along. I am glad, my friend. Come on. Let us find somewhere to enjoy a little time without a counter between us.

lore1320_gear_1.ogg.spoken: [practical interest, considerate, steady] How does it feel? Good equipment should be useful to the person wearing it. Take a moment to decide for yourself.
lore1320_gear_1.ogg.text: How does it feel? Good equipment should be useful to the person wearing it. Take a moment to decide for yourself.

lore1320_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [steady warmth, understated enthusiasm, welcoming] Ah, my friend. Shall we go out? I brought the old ball. There may be somewhere with enough room for a little game.
lore1320_greet_1.ogg.text: Ah, my friend. Shall we go out? I brought the old ball. There may be somewhere with enough room for a little game.

lore1320_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [mock dignity, fond amusement, relaxed] The ball is perfectly serviceable. Yes, I know how it looks. You should see how many good afternoons have gone into those scuffs.
lore1320_idle_1.ogg.text: The ball is perfectly serviceable. Yes, I know how it looks. You should see how many good afternoons have gone into those scuffs.

lore1323_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere affection, pleased, inviting] You came to bring me along. I am glad, my friend. Come on. It will be good to share some time beyond an order across the counter.
lore1323_befriended_1.ogg.text: You came to bring me along. I am glad, my friend. Come on. It will be good to share some time beyond an order across the counter.

lore1323_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [practical warmth, sincere interest, welcoming] Good to see you, my friend. Have you time for a walk? Tell me what the road has been like. News of an ordinary day would be welcome as well as another urgent request.
lore1323_greet_1.ogg.text: Good to see you, my friend. Have you time for a walk? Tell me what the road has been like. News of an ordinary day would be welcome as well as another urgent request.

lore1323_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [reflective hope, restrained affection, sincere] Lewis hopes to offer me a meal when Westfall is safe. I have thought about it. Good food, news of the land, time to hear about an ordinary day. I should be very glad to accept.
lore1323_idle_1.ogg.text: Lewis hopes to offer me a meal when Westfall is safe. I have thought about it. Good food, news of the land, time to hear about an ordinary day. I should be very glad to accept.

lore1323_mail_1.ogg.spoken: [attentive concern, practical purpose, warm] A message? Let us see who is waiting for an answer. A request from far away is still someone's immediate need.
lore1323_mail_1.ogg.text: A message? Let us see who is waiting for an answer. A request from far away is still someone's immediate need.

lore1324_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [restrained affection, pleased, warmly inviting] You came to bring me along. I am pleased, my friend. Come on. It will be good to have a little time to hear what you think.
lore1324_befriended_1.ogg.text: You came to bring me along. I am pleased, my friend. Come on. It will be good to have a little time to hear what you think.

lore1324_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [reserved warmth, dry humor, welcoming] Good to see you, my friend. Shall we take a walk? I could use another opinion about the horse. A wooden one. It is becoming a pony at a rather steady rate.
lore1324_greet_1.ogg.text: Good to see you, my friend. Shall we take a walk? I could use another opinion about the horse. A wooden one. It is becoming a pony at a rather steady rate.

lore1324_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [dry amusement, patient self-mockery, confiding] One hoof is still off the table. I could call the horse lively. Another correction, and I may have to call it a very small pony. You see why I am considering the description carefully.
lore1324_idle_1.ogg.text: One hoof is still off the table. I could call the horse lively. Another correction, and I may have to call it a very small pony. You see why I am considering the description carefully.

lore1324_learned_1.ogg.spoken: [measured encouragement, approving, thoughtful] There, you have made progress. Give yourself time to notice what worked before rushing into the next correction.
lore1324_learned_1.ogg.text: There, you have made progress. Give yourself time to notice what worked before rushing into the next correction.

lore1333_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere affection, pleased, inviting] You came to bring me along. I am glad, my friend. Come on. It will be good to share a little of the day and hear what has pleased you lately.
lore1333_befriended_1.ogg.text: You came to bring me along. I am glad, my friend. Come on. It will be good to share a little of the day and hear what has pleased you lately.

lore1333_gear_1.ogg.spoken: [practical interest, firm confidence, encouraging] Have a proper look at the workmanship. Does it suit what you mean to do? Good gear should give you an answer beyond the name on the rack.
lore1333_gear_1.ogg.text: Have a proper look at the workmanship. Does it suit what you mean to do? Good gear should give you an answer beyond the name on the rack.

lore1333_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [solid warmth, restrained excitement, welcoming] Ah, my friend. Have you time for a walk? Titan has another bud. The violet, I mean. It is a little thing, but I have been waiting. You must come and see it when it opens.
lore1333_greet_1.ogg.text: Ah, my friend. Have you time for a walk? Titan has another bud. The violet, I mean. It is a little thing, but I have been waiting. You must come and see it when it opens.

lore1333_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [fond amusement, quiet pride, confiding] I call the violet Titan. It has a second bud now. I am trying to wait patiently. Going back to look again doesn't make it open any sooner, but I keep finding a reason to pass the window.
lore1333_idle_1.ogg.text: I call the violet Titan. It has a second bud now. I am trying to wait patiently. Going back to look again doesn't make it open any sooner, but I keep finding a reason to pass the window.

lore1341_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [restrained affection, pleased, warmly inviting] You came to bring me along. I am pleased, my friend. Come on. It will be good to hear what has been occupying your thoughts.
lore1341_befriended_1.ogg.text: You came to bring me along. I am pleased, my friend. Come on. It will be good to hear what has been occupying your thoughts.

lore1341_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [steady warmth, dry amusement, welcoming] There you are, my friend. Have you time for a walk? I have been considering an opening move. You may tell me whether it is clever, or simply the one everyone tries first.
lore1341_greet_1.ogg.text: There you are, my friend. Have you time for a walk? I have been considering an opening move. You may tell me whether it is clever, or simply the one everyone tries first.

lore1341_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [fond amusement, interested curiosity, confiding] I have considered a very clever first move. Then a friend sits down, and I offer them the first turn. I want to see what they have thought of. There is always another game for my great discovery.
lore1341_idle_1.ogg.text: I have considered a very clever first move. Then a friend sits down, and I offer them the first turn. I want to see what they have thought of. There is always another game for my great discovery.

lore1341_rest_1.ogg.spoken: [relaxed warmth, playful interest, inviting] A seat sounds good. If we have room for the little board, you can have the first move. Otherwise, tell me what you would try. I am curious.
lore1341_rest_1.ogg.text: A seat sounds good. If we have room for the little board, you can have the first move. Otherwise, tell me what you would try. I am curious.

lore1351_bagsFull_1.ogg.spoken: [considerate, practical encouragement, calm] Perhaps we should make room before adding anything more. Keep the little things where they will not be crushed or forgotten.
lore1351_bagsFull_1.ogg.text: Perhaps we should make room before adding anything more. Keep the little things where they will not be crushed or forgotten.

lore1351_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere gratitude, affectionate, warmly inviting] You came to bring me along. Thank you. I am glad of your friendship, and glad to share a little of the road with you.
lore1351_befriended_1.ogg.text: You came to bring me along. Thank you. I am glad of your friendship, and glad to share a little of the road with you.

lore1351_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [gentle warmth, courteous, lightly amused] Welcome, my friend. Are we going out? Give me a moment. I should like to leave this little puzzle behind before it occupies the whole day.
lore1351_greet_1.ogg.text: Welcome, my friend. Are we going out? Give me a moment. I should like to leave this little puzzle behind before it occupies the whole day.

lore1351_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [reflective, humble amusement, confiding] The wooden rings are meant to come apart. I have yet to persuade them. Perhaps I should practice accepting the help I am so ready to offer.
lore1351_idle_1.ogg.text: The wooden rings are meant to come apart. I have yet to persuade them. Perhaps I should practice accepting the help I am so ready to offer.

lore1395_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [grateful affection, pleased, warmly inviting] You thought of bringing me along? Aye, friend, I'd like that. Indubitably. Come on. It'll be good to have someone to talk with while we see a little of the day.
lore1395_befriended_1.ogg.text: You thought of bringing me along? Aye, friend, I'd like that. Indubitably. Come on. It'll be good to have someone to talk with while we see a little of the day.

lore1395_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [weathered friendly warmth, pleased wordplay, welcoming] There you are. Have ye a moment? I've a fine new word to try out. Am I pleased to see a familiar face? Indubitably. Come on, then. Tell me how you've been.
lore1395_greet_1.ogg.text: There you are. Have ye a moment? I've a fine new word to try out. Am I pleased to see a familiar face? Indubitably. Come on, then. Tell me how you've been.

lore1395_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [wry delight, unhurried enunciation, confiding] Indubitably. A fine long word. I asked what it meant, and it means certainly. Well, I'm certainly glad when a friend stops to talk. There's a proper use for it straight away.
lore1395_idle_1.ogg.text: Indubitably. A fine long word. I asked what it meant, and it means certainly. Well, I'm certainly glad when a friend stops to talk. There's a proper use for it straight away.

lore1395_rest_1.ogg.spoken: [relaxed good humor, appreciative warmth, inviting] Sit a moment, friend. An ordinary bit of company can improve a day considerably. Considerably. Another good word. I'll try not to use all the long ones before you've had a turn.
lore1395_rest_1.ogg.text: Sit a moment, friend. An ordinary bit of company can improve a day considerably. Considerably. Another good word. I'll try not to use all the long ones before you've had a turn.

lore1402_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [surprised affection, restrained pleasure, inviting] You came to bring me along. Well, I'm glad of that. Come on, friend. A walk with someone who wants the company sounds good to me.
lore1402_befriended_1.ogg.text: You came to bring me along. Well, I'm glad of that. Come on, friend. A walk with someone who wants the company sounds good to me.

lore1402_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [rough warmth, cautious hope, conversational] Ah, there you are. Have you time for a walk? I've got a little plan. One bean, bit of cloth, nowhere to plant it yet. You may know a place with decent soil.
lore1402_greet_1.ogg.text: Ah, there you are. Have you time for a walk? I've got a little plan. One bean, bit of cloth, nowhere to plant it yet. You may know a place with decent soil.

lore1402_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [guarded tenderness, quiet hope, confiding] One bean. I call it seed, you understand. Makes tomorrow sound a bit more open. Haven't chosen the ground yet. I'd like someone there when I do. No grand occasion. Just company.
lore1402_idle_1.ogg.text: One bean. I call it seed, you understand. Makes tomorrow sound a bit more open. Haven't chosen the ground yet. I'd like someone there when I do. No grand occasion. Just company.

lore1402_zone_1.ogg.spoken: [tentative curiosity, practical interest, quietly hopeful] Different ground here. Give me a moment to look. A small thing might grow in the right patch, even if nobody has given the place much thought.
lore1402_zone_1.ogg.text: Different ground here. Give me a moment to look. A small thing might grow in the right patch, even if nobody has given the place much thought.

lore1427_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere, welcoming, easy warmth] You needn't have a message to bring. I'm glad to see you for your own sake. Shall we get out for a while?
lore1427_befriended_1.ogg.text: You needn't have a message to bring. I'm glad to see you for your own sake. Shall we get out for a while?

lore1427_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [friendly, relieved, pleasantly curious] A walk would do me good. I've been looking at stock all morning. Let's see what everyone else is doing.
lore1427_greet_1.ogg.text: A walk would do me good. I've been looking at stock all morning. Let's see what everyone else is doing.

lore1427_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [thoughtful, wistful, quietly hopeful] Picnic blankets. That's what the empty line is for. I'd like to fill an order for a pleasant day, for once.
lore1427_idle_1.ogg.text: Picnic blankets. That's what the empty line is for. I'd like to fill an order for a pleasant day, for once.

lore1427_quest_1.ogg.spoken: [warm appreciation, reassuring, earnest] Thank you. You made someone's day a little easier. I know how much a simple delivery can mean.
lore1427_quest_1.ogg.text: Thank you. You made someone's day a little easier. I know how much a simple delivery can mean.

lore1430_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [warm, touched voice, easy affection] You don't have to call me over only when a pot's in trouble. I'm glad to be here for myself.
lore1430_befriended_1.ogg.text: You don't have to call me over only when a pot's in trouble. I'm glad to be here for myself.

lore1430_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [warm, encouraging voice, friendly curiosity] Off we go, then. If we stop for a meal, perhaps you can show me what you've learned.
lore1430_greet_1.ogg.text: Off we go, then. If we stop for a meal, perhaps you can show me what you've learned.

lore1430_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [patient, thoughtful voice, gentle instruction] Taste it before adding anything else. Sometimes the next thing a dish needs is nothing.
lore1430_idle_1.ogg.text: Taste it before adding anything else. Sometimes the next thing a dish needs is nothing.

lore1430_rest_1.ogg.spoken: [warm, lightly self-conscious voice, amused restraint] A good moment for a meal. If you're cooking, I'll try very hard to stay out of your way.
lore1430_rest_1.ogg.text: A good moment for a meal. If you're cooking, I'll try very hard to stay out of your way.

lore1432_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere affection, warm pleasure, inviting] You came to bring me along. I am glad, my friend. Come on. It will be a pleasure to share the walk with you, quite apart from any business.
lore1432_befriended_1.ogg.text: You came to bring me along. I am glad, my friend. Come on. It will be a pleasure to share the walk with you, quite apart from any business.

lore1432_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [expansive friendliness, playful self-awareness, welcoming] Ah, my friend. Good to see you. Shall we take a walk? I have a little toast to practice. Little is the ambition, you understand. I may need you to tell me when the introduction has gone on long enough.
lore1432_greet_1.ogg.text: Ah, my friend. Good to see you. Shall we take a walk? I have a little toast to practice. Little is the ambition, you understand. I may need you to tell me when the introduction has gone on long enough.

lore1432_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [fond sincerity, amused self-mockery, thoughtful] I want to thank Suzetta. Two words. Somehow I keep putting a magnificent introduction in front of them. Perhaps I should begin with the two words, and have the courage to stop.
lore1432_idle_1.ogg.text: I want to thank Suzetta. Two words. Somehow I keep putting a magnificent introduction in front of them. Perhaps I should begin with the two words, and have the courage to stop.

lore1432_rest_1.ogg.spoken: [relaxed affection, pleased amusement, sincere] Sit with me a moment. I am glad you came. There, I managed a plain welcome. Rather a pleasant one, with the right person here to hear it.
lore1432_rest_1.ogg.text: Sit with me a moment. I am glad you came. There, I managed a plain welcome. Rather a pleasant one, with the right person here to hear it.

lore1433_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere affection, cheerful, unhurried] You make an ordinary walk feel like a day out. That's a fine thing in a friend. Shall we?
lore1433_befriended_1.ogg.text: You make an ordinary walk feel like a day out. That's a fine thing in a friend. Shall we?

lore1433_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [easygoing, cheerful, companionable] An outing together? Lovely. I've no bundle to carry this time. What a difference that makes.
lore1433_greet_1.ogg.text: An outing together? Lovely. I've no bundle to carry this time. What a difference that makes.

lore1433_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [fond, matter-of-fact, quietly amused] I saved a piece for Rema. Well, of course I did. No sense bringing home nothing but the wrapping.
lore1433_idle_1.ogg.text: I saved a piece for Rema. Well, of course I did. No sense bringing home nothing but the wrapping.

lore1433_quest_1.ogg.spoken: [satisfied, jovial, hopeful] Delivery made! Now, have we time to find something nice for lunch? I believe we've earned it.
lore1433_quest_1.ogg.text: Delivery made! Now, have we time to find something nice for lunch? I believe we've earned it.

lore14394_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [formal sincere affection, pleased, inviting] You would have me along? It would be my pleasure, my friend. Lead on. I should be glad to share a stretch of the road and hear what you have been doing.
lore14394_befriended_1.ogg.text: You would have me along? It would be my pleasure, my friend. Lead on. I should be glad to share a stretch of the road and hear what you have been doing.

lore14394_gear_1.ogg.spoken: [experienced practical interest, approving, measured] Look at the stitching and how the piece sits. Fine work ought to serve the person wearing it. A little care in the making can matter a great deal when it is put to use.
lore14394_gear_1.ogg.text: Look at the stitching and how the piece sits. Fine work ought to serve the person wearing it. A little care in the making can matter a great deal when it is put to use.

lore14394_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [dignified warmth, good-humored pride, welcoming] Shall we see the road beyond the arches? I have a small piece of leatherwork to tell you about. It may receive an announcement quite out of proportion to its size.
lore14394_greet_1.ogg.text: Shall we see the road beyond the arches? I have a small piece of leatherwork to tell you about. It may receive an announcement quite out of proportion to its size.

lore14394_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [solemn mock ceremony, pleased, gently amused] The spoon fits its leather case exactly. In, out, and securely back again. I have tested it more often than necessary. You may permit me a small celebration of the workmanship.
lore14394_idle_1.ogg.text: The spoon fits its leather case exactly. In, out, and securely back again. I have tested it more often than necessary. You may permit me a small celebration of the workmanship.

lore14423_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere affection, relaxed pleasure, inviting] You came to bring me along. I am glad, my friend. Come on. A walk and a proper conversation sound very welcome.
lore14423_befriended_1.ogg.text: You came to bring me along. I am glad, my friend. Come on. A walk and a proper conversation sound very welcome.

lore14423_gear_1.ogg.spoken: [practical interest, good-natured amusement, encouraging] Does it fit properly? Give it a fair try. I have learned that a thumb can be quite a small part of a glove and still require a great deal of attention.
lore14423_gear_1.ogg.text: Does it fit properly? Give it a fair try. I have learned that a thumb can be quite a small part of a glove and still require a great deal of attention.

lore14423_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [plainspoken warmth, mild amusement, welcoming] Good to see you, my friend. Have you time to walk with me? Tell me how you have been. I have made a little progress with that glove, though the thumb remains a subject of discussion.
lore14423_greet_1.ogg.text: Good to see you, my friend. Have you time to walk with me? Tell me how you have been. I have made a little progress with that glove, though the thumb remains a subject of discussion.

lore14423_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [modest pride, fond dry humor, confiding] The glove is warm, and most of it fits. The thumb is rather long. I keep trying it on anyway. There is a good deal of work there that I am pleased with.
lore14423_idle_1.ogg.text: The glove is warm, and most of it fits. The thumb is rather long. I keep trying it on anyway. There is a good deal of work there that I am pleased with.

lore14438_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [reserved affection, genuine interest, inviting] You came to bring me along. Gladly, my friend. Come. We need not decide every turn before we begin. I shall enjoy seeing what catches your interest.
lore14438_befriended_1.ogg.text: You came to bring me along. Gladly, my friend. Come. We need not decide every turn before we begin. I shall enjoy seeing what catches your interest.

lore14438_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [measured friendly interest, lightly amused, welcoming] There you are, my friend. Have you time for a pleasant walk? I have considered several routes. Then again, I should be interested to see which way you would choose.
lore14438_greet_1.ogg.text: There you are, my friend. Have you time for a pleasant walk? I have considered several routes. Then again, I should be interested to see which way you would choose.

lore14438_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [dry thoughtful humor, relaxed, confiding] I planned a pleasant short walk. Then I remembered another view, and another turn worth taking. It remains a pleasant walk. I am beginning to reconsider the word short.
lore14438_idle_1.ogg.text: I planned a pleasant short walk. Then I remembered another view, and another turn worth taking. It remains a pleasant walk. I am beginning to reconsider the word short.

lore14438_zone_1.ogg.spoken: [attentive curiosity, practical warmth, unhurried] A new place to look around. Let us get our bearings, then take a moment to notice it properly. There may be a turn worth remembering for another day.
lore14438_zone_1.ogg.text: A new place to look around. Let us get our bearings, then take a moment to notice it properly. There may be a turn worth remembering for another day.

lore14439_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere pleasure, easy affection, inviting] You came to bring me along. Gladly, my friend. Come on. It will be good to share a walk and hear what you have been up to.
lore14439_befriended_1.ogg.text: You came to bring me along. Gladly, my friend. Come on. It will be good to share a walk and hear what you have been up to.

lore14439_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [steady friendly confidence, relaxed, welcoming] Good to see you, my friend. Have you time for a walk? I shall be glad of the company. If you notice something I have missed, do point it out.
lore14439_greet_1.ogg.text: Good to see you, my friend. Have you time for a walk? I shall be glad of the company. If you notice something I have missed, do point it out.

lore14439_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [dry good humor, amused self-awareness, confiding] I pointed out a lion in the clouds. A magnificent creature, I thought. My companion said it was a potato. After another look, I had to admit it was a remarkably good potato.
lore14439_idle_1.ogg.text: I pointed out a lion in the clouds. A magnificent creature, I thought. My companion said it was a potato. After another look, I had to admit it was a remarkably good potato.

lore14439_rest_1.ogg.spoken: [relaxed warmth, gently playful, inviting] A pause sounds good. Give your feet a moment. We may even find time to look up and disagree about what we see. I promise to consider the potato fairly.
lore14439_rest_1.ogg.text: A pause sounds good. Give your feet a moment. We may even find time to look up and disagree about what we see. I promise to consider the potato fairly.

lore1444_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere gratitude, relieved affection, warm] You came looking for me. I am glad, my friend. It will be good to have someone beside me who needn't be persuaded to listen.
lore1444_befriended_1.ogg.text: You came looking for me. I am glad, my friend. It will be good to have someone beside me who needn't be persuaded to listen.

lore1444_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [thoughtful warmth, lightly nervous humor, welcoming] Ah, my friend. A walk sounds good. I have said the first sentence to the fountain often enough. Perhaps you would hear it once.
lore1444_greet_1.ogg.text: Ah, my friend. A walk sounds good. I have said the first sentence to the fountain often enough. Perhaps you would hear it once.

lore1444_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [confiding, self-deprecating amusement, thoughtful] The first sentence is always the troublesome one. After that, I remember I am speaking to people. Before it, I remember how many people there might be.
lore1444_idle_1.ogg.text: The first sentence is always the troublesome one. After that, I remember I am speaking to people. Before it, I remember how many people there might be.

lore1444_quest_1.ogg.spoken: [appreciative, thoughtful encouragement, warm] Well done. A little help in the right place can let someone else finish the work they have been waiting to do.
lore1444_quest_1.ogg.text: Well done. A little help in the right place can let someone else finish the work they have been waiting to do.

lore14722_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere affection, relaxed pleasure, inviting] You came to bring me along. I am pleased, my friend. Come on. It will be good to share a little of the day and hear what has been occupying your thoughts.
lore14722_befriended_1.ogg.text: You came to bring me along. I am pleased, my friend. Come on. It will be good to share a little of the day and hear what has been occupying your thoughts.

lore14722_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [cordial practical warmth, pleased, welcoming] Good to see you, my friend. Have you time for a walk? Come on. I should like to hear how your day has been, with no counting required on either side.
lore14722_greet_1.ogg.text: Good to see you, my friend. Have you time for a walk? Come on. I should like to hear how your day has been, with no counting required on either side.

lore14722_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [modest pleasure, gentle amusement, confiding] I have been folding my supper napkin into a crown. Sometimes it leans. I still make the effort when eating alone. An ordinary meal can be worth taking a little trouble over.
lore14722_idle_1.ogg.text: I have been folding my supper napkin into a crown. Sometimes it leans. I still make the effort when eating alone. An ordinary meal can be worth taking a little trouble over.

lore14722_quest_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere appreciation, practical encouragement, warm] Well done. Someone will be glad you saw that through. A shared effort depends on people willing to do their part, and their work deserves to be acknowledged.
lore14722_quest_1.ogg.text: Well done. Someone will be glad you saw that through. A shared effort depends on people willing to do their part, and their work deserves to be acknowledged.

lore1477_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere affection, pleased, inviting] You came to bring me along. I am glad, my friend. Come on. We can enjoy a little of the day and leave the account of it until later.
lore1477_befriended_1.ogg.text: You came to bring me along. I am glad, my friend. Come on. We can enjoy a little of the day and leave the account of it until later.

lore1477_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [easy warmth, dry humor, welcoming] There you are, my friend. Shall we take a walk? I have no heroic destination in mind. Somewhere with a comfortable seat would be quite enough to begin with.
lore1477_greet_1.ogg.text: There you are, my friend. Shall we take a walk? I have no heroic destination in mind. Somewhere with a comfortable seat would be quite enough to begin with.

lore1477_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [contented amusement, reflective warmth, unhurried] Nothing happened. We had a pleasant walk, found a seat, and everyone stayed in one piece. I should be very happy to give that account of the afternoon. A short story, but a fine ending.
lore1477_idle_1.ogg.text: Nothing happened. We had a pleasant walk, found a seat, and everyone stayed in one piece. I should be very happy to give that account of the afternoon. A short story, but a fine ending.

lore1477_rest_1.ogg.spoken: [settled contentment, friendly interest, warm] Now this is promising. A seat, good company and time to hear an answer. Tell me how you have been. We needn't hurry to the exciting part.
lore1477_rest_1.ogg.text: Now this is promising. A seat, good company and time to hear an answer. Tell me how you have been. We needn't hurry to the exciting part.

lore151_bagsFull_1.ogg.spoken: [practical, reassuring voice, calm instruction] Set the pack down. Sometimes you need better packing, not another bag.
lore151_bagsFull_1.ogg.text: Set the pack down. Sometimes you need better packing, not another bag.

lore151_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [reserved, warmly pleased voice] You ask because you're interested, not because something's broken. That's a pleasant change.
lore151_befriended_1.ogg.text: You ask because you're interested, not because something's broken. That's a pleasant change.

lore151_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [steady, practical voice, friendly assurance] Ready for the road? Give those straps a check, and I'll come along.
lore151_greet_1.ogg.text: Ready for the road? Give those straps a check, and I'll come along.

lore151_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [patient, matter-of-fact voice, quiet enthusiasm] The clever bit isn't tying a knot. It's making one you can undo when your fingers are cold.
lore151_idle_1.ogg.text: The clever bit isn't tying a knot. It's making one you can undo when your fingers are cold.

lore17804_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [earnest grateful affection, pleased, inviting] You thought to ask me along. Thank you, my friend. I should like that. Lead on; I shall try to be good company, and you can tell me what you have been doing.
lore17804_befriended_1.ogg.text: You thought to ask me along. Thank you, my friend. I should like that. Lead on; I shall try to be good company, and you can tell me what you have been doing.

lore17804_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [earnest youthful confidence, lightly self-conscious humor, welcoming] A walk together? Very well. I have been practicing an introduction. If it grows too grand, you may remind me that we are simply going for a walk. Come on, my friend.
lore17804_greet_1.ogg.text: A walk together? Very well. I have been practicing an introduction. If it grows too grand, you may remind me that we are simply going for a walk. Come on, my friend.

lore17804_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [hopeful reflection, modest determination, warm] Sir Rowe. Hm. It is easy enough to say. Becoming someone worthy of it will take rather more than a good introduction. I should begin by being ready when I am needed.
lore17804_idle_1.ogg.text: Sir Rowe. Hm. It is easy enough to say. Becoming someone worthy of it will take rather more than a good introduction. I should begin by being ready when I am needed.

lore17804_quest_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere admiration, earnest resolve, encouraging] A useful task, done when it was needed. I should like to be known for that. Titles can come afterward. Well done, my friend; someone can depend on you to see things through.
lore17804_quest_1.ogg.text: A useful task, done when it was needed. I should like to be known for that. Titles can come afterward. Well done, my friend; someone can depend on you to see things through.

lore2046_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [warm, sincerely pleased voice] I used to wonder whether my customers got home. With you, I get to ask.
lore2046_befriended_1.ogg.text: I used to wonder whether my customers got home. With you, I get to ask.

lore2046_combatEnd_1.ogg.spoken: [calm, reassuring voice, firm priorities] All right? Check yourself before the equipment. We can repair the rest.
lore2046_combatEnd_1.ogg.text: All right? Check yourself before the equipment. We can repair the rest.

lore2046_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [steady, welcoming voice, practical concern] Good to see you. Comfortable straps? Right, then. Let's go.
lore2046_greet_1.ogg.text: Good to see you. Comfortable straps? Right, then. Let's go.

lore2046_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [quiet, thoughtful voice, sincere conviction] A shield has an outside for the danger and an inside for the person who matters.
lore2046_idle_1.ogg.text: A shield has an outside for the danger and an inside for the person who matters.

lore205278_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [grateful affection, relieved warmth, welcoming] You thought to ask me along. Thank you, my friend. I am glad. It helps to have someone beside me for a while, and I should like to hear what is on your mind.
lore205278_befriended_1.ogg.text: You thought to ask me along. Thank you, my friend. I am glad. It helps to have someone beside me for a while, and I should like to hear what is on your mind.

lore205278_comforted_1.ogg.spoken: [soothing care, patient, quietly reassuring] Sit a moment, my friend. You needn't find the right words at once. I can stay here with you while you gather them. Tell me what you can, when you are ready.
lore205278_comforted_1.ogg.text: Sit a moment, my friend. You needn't find the right words at once. I can stay here with you while you gather them. Tell me what you can, when you are ready.

lore205278_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [gentle concern, grateful warmth, inviting] A little company would be welcome. Come, let us walk. If you have heard any news, I shall listen. If you haven't, tell me how you have been. I should be glad to hear that too.
lore205278_greet_1.ogg.text: A little company would be welcome. Come, let us walk. If you have heard any news, I shall listen. If you haven't, tell me how you have been. I should be glad to hear that too.

lore205278_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [reflective worry, tender hope, sincere] I think of all the questions I would ask if Ada came through the door. Then I think I would ask whether she had eaten. The rest could wait until she was warm and seated.
lore205278_idle_1.ogg.text: I think of all the questions I would ask if Ada came through the door. Then I think I would ask whether she had eaten. The rest could wait until she was warm and seated.

lore2198_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [warm delighted affection, personable, inviting] You came to bring me along! Gladly, my friend. Come on. I shall enjoy hearing about your day, and you needn't compete with the far end of the street.
lore2198_befriended_1.ogg.text: You came to bring me along! Gladly, my friend. Come on. I shall enjoy hearing about your day, and you needn't compete with the far end of the street.

lore2198_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [bright resonant warmth, clear diction, welcoming] There you are, my friend! Have you news of your own? Come on, we can walk while you tell me. I should like to hear what has been happening in your part of the world.
lore2198_greet_1.ogg.text: There you are, my friend! Have you news of your own? Come on, we can walk while you tell me. I should like to hear what has been happening in your part of the world.

lore2198_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [careful enunciation, pleased, amused at himself] Six silken sashes in seven silver sacks. There! Quite clear, at that speed. Now I am tempted to try it faster, which is generally where the sashes begin to win.
lore2198_idle_1.ogg.text: Six silken sashes in seven silver sacks. There! Quite clear, at that speed. Now I am tempted to try it faster, which is generally where the sashes begin to win.

lore2198_quest_1.ogg.spoken: [hearty sincere approval, celebratory, clear] Well done! That is news worth hearing. Give yourself a moment to enjoy it. A call for help has found someone willing to see the work through.
lore2198_quest_1.ogg.text: Well done! That is news worth hearing. Give yourself a moment to enjoy it. A call for help has found someone willing to see the work through.

lore234_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [warmly] You have my trust. That means more to me than another name on a muster roll.
lore234_befriended_1.ogg.text: You have my trust. That means more to me than another name on a muster roll.

lore234_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [steady] Come. Let us see what help we can offer beyond the hill.
lore234_greet_1.ogg.text: Come. Let us see what help we can offer beyond the hill.

lore234_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [thoughtfully] One day, the loudest thing in these fields will be a harvest wagon.
lore234_idle_1.ogg.text: One day, the loudest thing in these fields will be a harvest wagon.

lore234_quest_1.ogg.spoken: [thoughtfully] Useful work. Let us hope it brings someone a little closer to home.
lore234_quest_1.ogg.text: Useful work. Let us hope it brings someone a little closer to home.

lore240_bagsFull_1.ogg.spoken: [sighs] Leave room for supplies. You may need the walk home.
lore240_bagsFull_1.ogg.text: Leave room for supplies. You may need the walk home.

lore240_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: You've earned my trust. Try not to make me put that in triplicate.
lore240_befriended_1.ogg.text: You've earned my trust. Try not to make me put that in triplicate.

lore240_combatEnd_1.ogg.spoken: [laughs] Check on everyone before we move on.
lore240_combatEnd_1.ogg.text: Check on everyone before we move on.

lore240_combatStart_1.ogg.spoken: [shouting] Keep your footing. Watch each other's backs.
lore240_combatStart_1.ogg.text: Keep your footing. Watch each other's backs.

lore240_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [cheerfully] I'll have a look at these roads myself, then.
lore240_greet_1.ogg.text: I'll have a look at these roads myself, then.

lore240_greet_2.ogg.spoken: [warmly] Right. Show me what you've been dealing with.
lore240_greet_2.ogg.text: Right. Show me what you've been dealing with.

lore240_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [mischievously] One quiet afternoon. That's all I'm asking.
lore240_idle_1.ogg.text: One quiet afternoon. That's all I'm asking.

lore240_idle_2.ogg.spoken: [thoughtfully] If a kobold's carrying a book, I'd rather know the title.
lore240_idle_2.ogg.text: If a kobold's carrying a book, I'd rather know the title.

lore240_idle_3.ogg.spoken: [cheerfully] A blank report can be excellent news, provided someone actually checked.
lore240_idle_3.ogg.text: A blank report can be excellent news, provided someone actually checked.

lore240_levelUp_1.ogg.spoken: [excited] You've come a long way since your first report.
lore240_levelUp_1.ogg.text: You've come a long way since your first report.

lore240_loot_1.ogg.spoken: [excited] Anything that explains what they were doing out here?
lore240_loot_1.ogg.text: Anything that explains what they were doing out here?

lore240_poke_1.ogg.spoken: [annoyed] Yes? You can give the report without prodding me.
lore240_poke_1.ogg.text: Yes? You can give the report without prodding me.

lore240_quest_1.ogg.spoken: [cheerfully] Good work. Tell me what you saw, while it's fresh.
lore240_quest_1.ogg.text: Good work. Tell me what you saw, while it's fresh.

lore240_zone_1.ogg.spoken: [excited] Different roads, same rule: know where your people are.
lore240_zone_1.ogg.text: Different roads, same rule: know where your people are.

lore241_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [slightly surprised, sincerely touched voice] Funny thing. You came back when there wasn't a deal waiting. I'm glad you did.
lore241_befriended_1.ogg.text: Funny thing. You came back when there wasn't a deal waiting. I'm glad you did.

lore241_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [genial merchant voice, warmly pleased] A traveling partner! Now that's a good start. A good start.
lore241_greet_1.ogg.text: A traveling partner! Now that's a good start. A good start.

lore241_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [thoughtful, warm voice, unhurried] Gold dust is worth counting. So are the people who stop to listen.
lore241_idle_1.ogg.text: Gold dust is worth counting. So are the people who stop to listen.

lore241_quest_1.ogg.spoken: [relieved voice, restrained concern] They listened? Good. Some warnings need more than a merchant behind them.
lore241_quest_1.ogg.text: They listened? Good. Some warnings need more than a merchant behind them.

lore250_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [reserved, sincere voice, hard-earned respect] You do what you say you'll do. I've learned I can count on that.
lore250_befriended_1.ogg.text: You do what you say you'll do. I've learned I can count on that.

lore250_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [firm, weathered voice, restrained welcome] Ready? Good. There's daylight yet, and no sense wasting all of it talking.
lore250_greet_1.ogg.text: Ready? Good. There's daylight yet, and no sense wasting all of it talking.

lore250_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [practical, thoughtful voice, measured certainty] Tie a vine too tightly and you'll harm the very thing you're trying to support.
lore250_idle_1.ogg.text: Tie a vine too tightly and you'll harm the very thing you're trying to support.

lore250_quest_1.ogg.spoken: [firm, approving voice, plainspoken pride] Work finished properly. That's worth more than a grand promise.
lore250_quest_1.ogg.text: Work finished properly. That's worth more than a grand promise.

lore252_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [warm, sincerely relieved voice] You don't make me feel foolish for hoping. That's a good kind of friend to have.
lore252_befriended_1.ogg.text: You don't make me feel foolish for hoping. That's a good kind of friend to have.

lore252_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [friendly, bashful voice, surprised amusement] Oh, hello! I wasn't talking to the river. Well... perhaps a little.
lore252_greet_1.ogg.text: Oh, hello! I wasn't talking to the river. Well... perhaps a little.

lore252_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [sheepish, lightly amused voice] The speech went much better when there wasn't anyone to hear it.
lore252_idle_1.ogg.text: The speech went much better when there wasn't anyone to hear it.

lore252_quest_1.ogg.spoken: [hopeful, encouraged voice, growing confidence] You found a way to help? Good. I like hearing that a difficult thing isn't impossible.
lore252_quest_1.ogg.text: You found a way to help? Good. I like hearing that a difficult thing isn't impossible.

lore253_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [warmly] A trusted friend! Someone I can hand a sealed letter without a second thought.
lore253_befriended_1.ogg.text: A trusted friend! Someone I can hand a sealed letter without a second thought.

lore253_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [warmly] Ah, my traveling associate! Clean hands, I trust?
lore253_greet_1.ogg.text: Ah, my traveling associate! Clean hands, I trust?

lore253_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [thoughtfully] If only family feuds dissolved as easily as candle wax.
lore253_idle_1.ogg.text: If only family feuds dissolved as easily as candle wax.

lore253_quest_1.ogg.spoken: [pleased] A useful day's work. I hope we've made someone's life a little easier.
lore253_quest_1.ogg.text: A useful day's work. I hope we've made someone's life a little easier.

lore255_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [warm, quietly delighted voice] You come by even when there's nothing to trade. I like that very much.
lore255_befriended_1.ogg.text: You come by even when there's nothing to trade. I like that very much.

lore255_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [easygoing, friendly voice, unhurried warmth] A walk? Gladly. Let me fill my waterskin before we start.
lore255_greet_1.ogg.text: A walk? Gladly. Let me fill my waterskin before we start.

lore255_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [relaxed, contented voice, conversational warmth] An apple and cool water. You can make an afternoon better without making it complicated.
lore255_idle_1.ogg.text: An apple and cool water. You can make an afternoon better without making it complicated.

lore255_rest_1.ogg.spoken: [playfully persuasive voice, relaxed good humor] Fine bit of shade. We ought to give it a proper try before moving on.
lore255_rest_1.ogg.text: Fine bit of shade. We ought to give it a proper try before moving on.

lore258_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [warm, sincerely appreciative voice] You tell me what you think, even when we disagree. I like knowing where I stand with a friend.
lore258_befriended_1.ogg.text: You tell me what you think, even when we disagree. I like knowing where I stand with a friend.

lore258_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [genial, conversational voice, friendly welcome] Good to see you! Something for the road before we set off?
lore258_greet_1.ogg.text: Good to see you! Something for the road before we set off?

lore258_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [wryly amused voice, relaxed warmth] You needn't use a grand word for something you like. Good will do nicely.
lore258_idle_1.ogg.text: You needn't use a grand word for something you like. Good will do nicely.

lore258_rest_1.ogg.spoken: [easygoing, hospitable voice, playful assurance] Sit down, have a drink, tell me what you think. No grand description required.
lore258_rest_1.ogg.text: Sit down, have a drink, tell me what you think. No grand description required.

lore2708_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere warmth, relieved, welcoming] A friend, rather than another obligation. I'm glad. You may remind me to look up from the work now and then.
lore2708_befriended_1.ogg.text: A friend, rather than another obligation. I'm glad. You may remind me to look up from the work now and then.

lore2708_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [thoughtful, distracted at first, warming with recognition] Ah, there you are. No report today? An outing? Yes, that would be very welcome. I've had quite enough correspondence.
lore2708_greet_1.ogg.text: Ah, there you are. No report today? An outing? Yes, that would be very welcome. I've had quite enough correspondence.

lore2708_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [reflective, candid, warm self-awareness] I rehearse the good news for Trelane. Then I abandon the speech. Strange, isn't it? An archmage still hoping to please his first teacher.
lore2708_idle_1.ogg.text: I rehearse the good news for Trelane. Then I abandon the speech. Strange, isn't it? An archmage still hoping to please his first teacher.

lore2708_quest_1.ogg.spoken: [warm approval, pleased surprise, grateful] A result delivered. Wonderful. Someone will be very pleased to hear that their trust was well placed.
lore2708_quest_1.ogg.text: A result delivered. Wonderful. Someone will be very pleased to hear that their trust was well placed.

lore2795_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere pleasure, fond informality, inviting] You came to bring me along. Gladly, my friend. Come on. It will be good to spend a little time together, with or without a perfect performance.
lore2795_befriended_1.ogg.text: You came to bring me along. Gladly, my friend. Come on. It will be good to spend a little time together, with or without a perfect performance.

lore2795_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [easy familiar warmth, playful confidence, welcoming] There you are, my friend. Have you a moment? I have been practicing that coin trick. Come on, we can walk. I should like to hear what has been occupying your hands lately.
lore2795_greet_1.ogg.text: There you are, my friend. Have you a moment? I have been practicing that coin trick. Come on, we can walk. I should like to hear what has been occupying your hands lately.

lore2795_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [wry self-awareness, amused, confiding] I can roll the coin across my knuckles without looking. Then a friend watches, and down go my eyes. I want them to see it go well. Apparently, I want to see it go well too.
lore2795_idle_1.ogg.text: I can roll the coin across my knuckles without looking. Then a friend watches, and down go my eyes. I want them to see it go well. Apparently, I want to see it go well too.

lore2795_loot_1.ogg.spoken: [practical interest, dry playful advice, friendly] A useful find? Have a proper look. If it happens to be a coin, I recommend keeping a hand underneath it until you are quite certain of your technique.
lore2795_loot_1.ogg.text: A useful find? Have a proper look. If it happens to be a coin, I recommend keeping a hand underneath it until you are quite certain of your technique.

lore279_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [warm, sincere voice, quietly pleased] You've stayed long enough to know me beyond the shop. I'm glad of that.
lore279_befriended_1.ogg.text: You've stayed long enough to know me beyond the shop. I'm glad of that.

lore279_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [welcoming, lively voice, friendly curiosity] There you are! No counter between us today. What shall we investigate?
lore279_greet_1.ogg.text: There you are! No counter between us today. What shall we investigate?

lore279_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [thoughtful, lightly amused voice] I do enjoy a good question. Especially one that changes my answer.
lore279_idle_1.ogg.text: I do enjoy a good question. Especially one that changes my answer.

lore279_quest_1.ogg.spoken: [bright, appreciative voice, affectionate curiosity] Delivered safely? Splendid. Was there any news from William?
lore279_quest_1.ogg.text: Delivered safely? Splendid. Was there any news from William?

lore295_bagsFull_1.ogg.spoken: [sighs] That's a lot to leave under a bed by mistake.
lore295_bagsFull_1.ogg.text: That's a lot to leave under a bed by mistake.

lore295_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: Next time Falkhaan sends someone, I'll tell them to look for you, too.
lore295_befriended_1.ogg.text: Next time Falkhaan sends someone, I'll tell them to look for you, too.

lore295_combatEnd_1.ogg.spoken: [relieved] Everyone still here? Good. Take a breath.
lore295_combatEnd_1.ogg.text: Everyone still here? Good. Take a breath.

lore295_died_1.ogg.spoken: [sighs] Oh, my friend. I wish a warm room could fix everything.
lore295_died_1.ogg.text: Oh, my friend. I wish a warm room could fix everything.

lore295_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [excited] Well! Someone else can mind the counter for a bit.
lore295_greet_1.ogg.text: Well! Someone else can mind the counter for a bit.

lore295_greet_2.ogg.spoken: [excited] Out we go. Did you remember your cloak?
lore295_greet_2.ogg.text: Out we go. Did you remember your cloak?

lore295_hearth_1.ogg.spoken: [cheerfully] Home for a spell? Good. Even heroes need somewhere to leave their boots.
lore295_hearth_1.ogg.text: Home for a spell? Good. Even heroes need somewhere to leave their boots.

lore295_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [mischievously] I ought to be polishing something. Old habit.
lore295_idle_1.ogg.text: I ought to be polishing something. Old habit.

lore295_idle_2.ogg.spoken: [thoughtfully] Amazing how far a lost glove can travel without its owner.
lore295_idle_2.ogg.text: Amazing how far a lost glove can travel without its owner.

lore295_idle_3.ogg.spoken: [cheerfully] Wonder who's sitting in your usual chair tonight.
lore295_idle_3.ogg.text: Wonder who's sitting in your usual chair tonight.

lore295_levelUp_1.ogg.spoken: [overjoyed] Look how far you've come! I'll still remember you before all that fancy armor.
lore295_levelUp_1.ogg.text: Look how far you've come! I'll still remember you before all that fancy armor.

lore295_poke_1.ogg.spoken: [playfully] Yes, yes, I heard you. There's no counter between us now.
lore295_poke_1.ogg.text: Yes, yes, I heard you. There's no counter between us now.

lore295_poke_2.ogg.spoken: [annoyed] That isn't how you ring for service!
lore295_poke_2.ogg.text: That isn't how you ring for service!

lore295_quest_1.ogg.spoken: [proudly] Another favor done. I hope they offered you a seat.
lore295_quest_1.ogg.text: Another favor done. I hope they offered you a seat.

lore295_rest_1.ogg.spoken: [contentedly] There we are. Sit before your knees make the decision for you.
lore295_rest_1.ogg.text: There we are. Sit before your knees make the decision for you.

lore328_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [reserved, sincere voice, gentle warmth] You ask what interests me when there isn't a lesson to be had. I appreciate that more than I expected.
lore328_befriended_1.ogg.text: You ask what interests me when there isn't a lesson to be had. I appreciate that more than I expected.

lore328_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [composed, precise voice, dry amusement] Good. A walk gives us time to observe things without setting any of them alight.
lore328_greet_1.ogg.text: Good. A walk gives us time to observe things without setting any of them alight.

lore328_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [thoughtful, quietly delighted voice] A thing needn't be enchanted to deserve a closer look.
lore328_idle_1.ogg.text: A thing needn't be enchanted to deserve a closer look.

lore328_quest_1.ogg.spoken: [measured, approving voice, curious invitation] Well done. Tell me what you observed, not only what you expected to find.
lore328_quest_1.ogg.text: Well done. Tell me what you observed, not only what you expected to find.

lore3518_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere affection, quietly delighted, inviting] You came to bring me along. I am pleased, my friend. Come on. It will be good to share a walk with no sale needed at the end of it.
lore3518_befriended_1.ogg.text: You came to bring me along. I am pleased, my friend. Come on. It will be good to share a walk with no sale needed at the end of it.

lore3518_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [open warmth, cheerful familiarity, welcoming] Ah, my friend. Good to see you. Come a little way with me. There is always bread to sell, but I should like to hear how your day has been going.
lore3518_greet_1.ogg.text: Ah, my friend. Good to see you. Come a little way with me. There is always bread to sell, but I should like to hear how your day has been going.

lore3518_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [fond amusement, reflective warmth, conversational] I tried drawing my route from memory. Put in all the people I look forward to greeting, and forgot half the streets. Not much use as a map. Quite a pleasant thing to look at.
lore3518_idle_1.ogg.text: I tried drawing my route from memory. Put in all the people I look forward to greeting, and forgot half the streets. Not much use as a map. Quite a pleasant thing to look at.

lore3518_zone_1.ogg.spoken: [friendly curiosity, warm anticipation, unhurried] A new route today. Let us take time to notice who is here. A friendly greeting may be the part we remember best.
lore3518_zone_1.ogg.text: A new route today. Let us take time to notice who is here. A friendly greeting may be the part we remember best.

lore352_bagsFull_1.ogg.spoken: [sighs] Pack it evenly. One side shouldn't weigh more than the rider.
lore352_bagsFull_1.ogg.text: Pack it evenly. One side shouldn't weigh more than the rider.

lore352_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: A familiar face at the roost. Makes the whole day easier.
lore352_befriended_1.ogg.text: A familiar face at the roost. Makes the whole day easier.

lore352_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [cheerfully] A journey on foot? I'll try to remember how those work.
lore352_greet_1.ogg.text: A journey on foot? I'll try to remember how those work.

lore352_greet_2.ogg.spoken: [cheerfully] Right, then. Who's watching the gryphons?
lore352_greet_2.ogg.text: Right, then. Who's watching the gryphons?

lore352_hearth_1.ogg.spoken: [cheerfully] Neat trick. Doesn't give you much of a view, mind.
lore352_hearth_1.ogg.text: Neat trick. Doesn't give you much of a view, mind.

lore352_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [cheerfully] You can tell a hungry gryphon from a cross one. Usually.
lore352_idle_1.ogg.text: You can tell a hungry gryphon from a cross one. Usually.

lore352_idle_2.ogg.spoken: [thoughtfully] Thor will say his birds are faster. Ask him which way the wind was blowing.
lore352_idle_2.ogg.text: Thor will say his birds are faster. Ask him which way the wind was blowing.

lore352_idle_3.ogg.spoken: [mischievously] No, I wasn't humming. That was my boot.
lore352_idle_3.ogg.text: No, I wasn't humming. That was my boot.

lore352_landed_1.ogg.spoken: [relieved] There! A proper landing. Give the bird a little credit.
lore352_landed_1.ogg.text: There! A proper landing. Give the bird a little credit.

lore352_levelUp_1.ogg.spoken: [proudly] Look at you now! Hard to believe you ever needed directions.
lore352_levelUp_1.ogg.text: Look at you now! Hard to believe you ever needed directions.
