lore352_mount_1.ogg.spoken: [excited] Perfectly respectable. Bit short on wings, though.
lore352_mount_1.ogg.text: Perfectly respectable. Bit short on wings, though.

lore352_poke_1.ogg.spoken: [giggles] That's where a gryphon would nip you back.
lore352_poke_1.ogg.text: That's where a gryphon would nip you back.

lore352_poke_2.ogg.spoken: [annoyed] Easy. I'm not a saddle that needs adjusting.
lore352_poke_2.ogg.text: Easy. I'm not a saddle that needs adjusting.

lore352_quest_1.ogg.spoken: [proudly] A delivery? Osric's crates would look light beside that lot.
lore352_quest_1.ogg.text: A delivery? Osric's crates would look light beside that lot.

lore352_taxi_1.ogg.spoken: [excited] Straps first. Admire the view once we're clear.
lore352_taxi_1.ogg.text: Straps first. Admire the view once we're clear.

lore3627_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [delighted, spontaneous warmth, welcoming] You came looking for me! Excellent. Come along, my friend. Today I get to enjoy the company I am always telling everyone about.
lore3627_befriended_1.ogg.text: You came looking for me! Excellent. Come along, my friend. Today I get to enjoy the company I am always telling everyone about.

lore3627_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [bright projecting voice, theatrical enthusiasm, friendly] There you are! My favorite sort of passerby: one who comes back. Shall we go out? I could use someone with a better line than mine.
lore3627_greet_1.ogg.text: There you are! My favorite sort of passerby: one who comes back. Shall we go out? I could use someone with a better line than mine.

lore3627_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [animated amusement, appreciative, confiding] Someone called back a splendid line the other morning. Better than mine. I have been wanting to borrow it ever since. I shall ask first.
lore3627_idle_1.ogg.text: Someone called back a splendid line the other morning. Better than mine. I have been wanting to borrow it ever since. I shall ask first.

lore3627_zone_1.ogg.spoken: [eager curiosity, upbeat, expressive] New surroundings! Let us find something worth telling people about. Every place deserves at least one good invitation.
lore3627_zone_1.ogg.text: New surroundings! Let us find something worth telling people about. Every place deserves at least one good invitation.

lore3935_bagsFull_1.ogg.spoken: [practical, wry voice, gentle instruction] Keep the provisions together, away from anything that leaks. Your spare shirt will thank you.
lore3935_bagsFull_1.ogg.text: Keep the provisions together, away from anything that leaks. Your spare shirt will thank you.

lore3935_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [quiet, sincere voice, appreciative warmth] You notice the care that goes into things. It's good having a friend who does.
lore3935_befriended_1.ogg.text: You notice the care that goes into things. It's good having a friend who does.

lore3935_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [grounded, businesslike voice, kindly interest] How far today? Tell me while I wrap something for the road.
lore3935_greet_1.ogg.text: How far today? Tell me while I wrap something for the road.

lore3935_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [dryly amused, practical voice] Pack for the journey you're taking, not the appetite you had before breakfast.
lore3935_idle_1.ogg.text: Pack for the journey you're taking, not the appetite you had before breakfast.

lore4078_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere affection, quietly excited, trusting] I am glad you came back for me. This time I shall hear the story as it happens. Lead on, my friend.
lore4078_befriended_1.ogg.text: I am glad you came back for me. This time I shall hear the story as it happens. Lead on, my friend.

lore4078_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [warm curiosity, thoughtful, welcoming] Ah, my friend. Shall we take a walk? There are places on my map I have only ever heard described.
lore4078_greet_1.ogg.text: Ah, my friend. Shall we take a walk? There are places on my map I have only ever heard described.

lore4078_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [reflective, hopeful, quiet amusement] Someone described a lovely view to me, then forgot its name. I have left a space on my map. Perhaps we shall find it.
lore4078_idle_1.ogg.text: Someone described a lovely view to me, then forgot its name. I have left a space on my map. Perhaps we shall find it.

lore4078_quest_1.ogg.spoken: [pleased, interested, warmly encouraging] Well done. When you tell me about it, begin at the beginning. I should hate to miss the interesting part.
lore4078_quest_1.ogg.text: Well done. When you tell me about it, begin at the beginning. I should hate to miss the interesting part.

lore465_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [warm, sincerely appreciative voice] You remember to ask how my day's been. It's a pleasure having someone listen back.
lore465_befriended_1.ogg.text: You remember to ask how my day's been. It's a pleasure having someone listen back.

lore465_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [genial, lively voice, eager curiosity] Ah, there you are! Tell me the rest of that story while we walk.
lore465_greet_1.ogg.text: Ah, there you are! Tell me the rest of that story while we walk.

lore465_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [wryly amused voice, conversational warmth] Every tale gets to the interesting bit just as someone wants another drink.
lore465_idle_1.ogg.text: Every tale gets to the interesting bit just as someone wants another drink.

lore465_rest_1.ogg.spoken: [relaxed, attentive voice, friendly invitation] Sit a while. No orders to fill here; I've time to hear the whole thing.
lore465_rest_1.ogg.text: Sit a while. No orders to fill here; I've time to hear the whole thing.

lore466_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [reserved sincere affection, pleased, inviting] You asked for my company. Gladly, my friend. Come on. Let us share a little of the day. I am pleased you thought to include me in it.
lore466_befriended_1.ogg.text: You asked for my company. Gladly, my friend. Come on. Let us share a little of the day. I am pleased you thought to include me in it.

lore466_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [commanding warmth, composed interest, welcoming] At ease, my friend. Have you time for a little company? Tell me how the road has treated you. I should like to hear from the person who traveled it as well as receive the account.
lore466_greet_1.ogg.text: At ease, my friend. Have you time for a little company? Tell me how the road has treated you. I should like to hear from the person who traveled it as well as receive the account.

lore466_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [dignified dry humor, quietly proud, confiding] A well-kept mustache does no harm to a commander's bearing. I give mine a little attention before an important greeting. You may be good enough to regard that as routine preparation.
lore466_idle_1.ogg.text: A well-kept mustache does no harm to a commander's bearing. I give mine a little attention before an important greeting. You may be good enough to regard that as routine preparation.

lore466_loot_1.ogg.spoken: [grave care, practical compassion, deliberate] Look before you discard it. An old insignia may mean little to the person who finds it and a great deal to a family waiting for something of their own to be returned.
lore466_loot_1.ogg.text: Look before you discard it. An old insignia may mean little to the person who finds it and a great deal to a family waiting for something of their own to be returned.

lore4974_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere gratitude, warm affection, welcoming] You thought to invite me. Thank you. I am very glad to come along, my friend. No formalities required.
lore4974_befriended_1.ogg.text: You thought to invite me. Thank you. I am very glad to come along, my friend. No formalities required.

lore4974_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [courteous warmth, dry humor, quietly pleased] Ah, my friend. An outing? Excellent. I shall leave the paperwork here. For once, we needn't agree on a name before we go.
lore4974_greet_1.ogg.text: Ah, my friend. An outing? Excellent. I shall leave the paperwork here. For once, we needn't agree on a name before we go.

lore4974_group_1.ogg.spoken: [friendly authority, considerate, lightly amused] A fine gathering. Before we choose a direction, does everyone have what they need? Even the quiet one at the back?
lore4974_group_1.ogg.text: A fine gathering. Before we choose a direction, does everyone have what they need? Even the quiet one at the back?

lore4974_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [confiding, restrained amusement, relaxed] A teacup and crossed biscuits. An entirely imaginary guild crest. Its meetings would have no agenda. I find the idea quite restful.
lore4974_idle_1.ogg.text: A teacup and crossed biscuits. An entirely imaginary guild crest. Its meetings would have no agenda. I find the idea quite restful.

lore4981_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere affection, pleased, inviting] You came to bring me along. I am glad, my friend. Come on. We can enjoy a little of the day without deciding what to call it.
lore4981_befriended_1.ogg.text: You came to bring me along. I am glad, my friend. Come on. We can enjoy a little of the day without deciding what to call it.

lore4981_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [friendly enthusiasm, sheepish amusement, welcoming] There you are, my friend. Shall we take a walk? I have another possible name for my cheese. No cheese yet, I admit. You may have to keep me sensible.
lore4981_greet_1.ogg.text: There you are, my friend. Shall we take a walk? I have another possible name for my cheese. No cheese yet, I admit. You may have to keep me sensible.

lore4981_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [self-mocking amusement, hopeful, confiding] Ben's Magnificent. That is as far as the name goes. Possibly I should learn to make the cheese before adding another word. Magnificent is already asking quite a lot.
lore4981_idle_1.ogg.text: Ben's Magnificent. That is as far as the name goes. Possibly I should learn to make the cheese before adding another word. Magnificent is already asking quite a lot.

lore4981_learned_1.ogg.spoken: [warm encouragement, interested, sincerely pleased] There, another thing you can do. Be pleased with it. I like seeing an ambition turn into something real, one lesson at a time.
lore4981_learned_1.ogg.text: There, another thing you can do. Be pleased with it. I like seeing an ambition turn into something real, one lesson at a time.

lore514_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [gruff, warmly sincere voice] You know when to talk work and when to let it rest. I appreciate that.
lore514_befriended_1.ogg.text: You know when to talk work and when to let it rest. I appreciate that.

lore514_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [rough, practical voice, pleasantly surprised] A break from the anvil? All right. You have my attention.
lore514_greet_1.ogg.text: A break from the anvil? All right. You have my attention.

lore514_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [thoughtful, gruff voice, quietly hopeful] A good bell shouldn't sound like another order being shouted.
lore514_idle_1.ogg.text: A good bell shouldn't sound like another order being shouted.

lore514_rest_1.ogg.spoken: [firm, practical voice, caring restraint] Set the tools down. Good work needs rested hands.
lore514_rest_1.ogg.text: Set the tools down. Good work needs rested hands.

lore523_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: A friend of mine flies at the front of the line. Well. Near the front.
lore523_befriended_1.ogg.text: A friend of mine flies at the front of the line. Well. Near the front.

lore523_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [cheerfully] Need a lift? You came to the right hill.
lore523_greet_1.ogg.text: Need a lift? You came to the right hill.

lore523_greet_2.ogg.spoken: [excited] Wind's from the south today. Good flying weather.
lore523_greet_2.ogg.text: Wind's from the south today. Good flying weather.

lore523_hearth_1.ogg.spoken: [cheerfully] A hearthstone. Faster than a gryphon, I'll admit. Barely.
lore523_hearth_1.ogg.text: A hearthstone. Faster than a gryphon, I'll admit. Barely.

lore523_idle_2.ogg.spoken: [cheerfully] Somewhere a courier is late, and I will hear about it.
lore523_idle_2.ogg.text: Somewhere a courier is late, and I will hear about it.

lore523_idle_3.ogg.spoken: [mischievously] If you see a storm cloud, don't tell the birds.
lore523_idle_3.ogg.text: If you see a storm cloud, don't tell the birds.

lore523_landed_1.ogg.spoken: [relieved] Not bad. I'd have landed it softer, but not bad.
lore523_landed_1.ogg.text: Not bad. I'd have landed it softer, but not bad.

lore523_levelUp_1.ogg.spoken: [excited] Another level! The birds will want to hear about this.
lore523_levelUp_1.ogg.text: Another level! The birds will want to hear about this.

lore523_mount_1.ogg.spoken: [excited] A mount? Fine. A gryphon would be faster, but fine.
lore523_mount_1.ogg.text: A mount? Fine. A gryphon would be faster, but fine.

lore523_poke_1.ogg.spoken: [giggles] Careful, these pockets are full of gryphon feed.
lore523_poke_1.ogg.text: Careful, these pockets are full of gryphon feed.

lore523_poke_2.ogg.spoken: [playfully] Need a ride? Oh, right. We're walking.
lore523_poke_2.ogg.text: Need a ride? Oh, right. We're walking.

lore523_quest_1.ogg.spoken: [excited] Another errand run! Lewis would be proud.
lore523_quest_1.ogg.text: Another errand run! Lewis would be proud.

lore523_taxi_1.ogg.spoken: [excited] A flight! I hope they're feeding that bird properly.
lore523_taxi_1.ogg.text: A flight! I hope they're feeding that bird properly.

lore523_zone_1.ogg.say: I know the flight path from here!
lore523_zone_1.ogg.spoken: [excited] I know the flight path from here!
lore523_zone_1.ogg.text: {zone}! I know the flight path from here.

lore5484_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [reserved affection, sincere, quietly welcoming] You have made time for me again. I am glad of it, my friend. Come along. We can leave the lessons in the hall for a while.
lore5484_befriended_1.ogg.text: You have made time for me again. I am glad of it, my friend. Come along. We can leave the lessons in the hall for a while.

lore5484_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [firm warmth, thoughtful, restrained amusement] There you are. A walk? Good. I have been turning the same thought over along the same stretch of floor. Let us give it some room.
lore5484_greet_1.ogg.text: There you are. A walk? Good. I have been turning the same thought over along the same stretch of floor. Let us give it some room.

lore5484_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [dry humor, thoughtful, quietly fond] I count my steps when I am thinking. Then someone brings me a question, and I lose count. A worthwhile interruption, usually.
lore5484_idle_1.ogg.text: I count my steps when I am thinking. Then someone brings me a question, and I lose count. A worthwhile interruption, usually.

lore5484_learned_1.ogg.spoken: [firm approval, focused encouragement, steady] Good. Practice it while you remember where the difficult part was. Understanding improves when you return to the work.
lore5484_learned_1.ogg.text: Good. Practice it while you remember where the difficult part was. Understanding improves when you return to the work.

lore5489_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere affection, pleased, welcoming] You came to bring me along. I am grateful, my friend. It will be good to share more than a greeting with you today.
lore5489_befriended_1.ogg.text: You came to bring me along. I am grateful, my friend. It will be good to share more than a greeting with you today.

lore5489_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [courteous warmth, curious, lightly amused] Welcome, my friend. Shall we go out? You might teach me a greeting for the road. I have been practicing the last one.
lore5489_greet_1.ogg.text: Welcome, my friend. Shall we go out? You might teach me a greeting for the road. I have been practicing the last one.

lore5489_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [humble amusement, interested, warm] An unfamiliar greeting takes practice. I ask people to repeat it. They have been very patient with me, especially over the sounds I thought I already knew.
lore5489_idle_1.ogg.text: An unfamiliar greeting takes practice. I ask people to repeat it. They have been very patient with me, especially over the sounds I thought I already knew.

lore5489_zone_1.ogg.spoken: [thoughtful curiosity, open and attentive, calm] Another place, another welcome to learn. Let us listen before assuming we know how everyone here does things.
lore5489_zone_1.ogg.text: Another place, another welcome to learn. Let us listen before assuming we know how everyone here does things.

lore5491_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere affection, relaxed dignity, welcoming] You came to bring me along. I am glad, my friend. There is no lesson to earn today. Let us enjoy the road together.
lore5491_befriended_1.ogg.text: You came to bring me along. I am glad, my friend. There is no lesson to earn today. Let us enjoy the road together.

lore5491_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [steady warmth, dignified, quietly playful] Well met, my friend. A walk would be welcome. If we pass a good stretch of water, I may ask you to keep count for me.
lore5491_greet_1.ogg.text: Well met, my friend. A walk would be welcome. If we pass a good stretch of water, I may ask you to keep count for me.

lore5491_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [dry self-awareness, sheepish amusement, warm] I remember the count of my best throw. Entirely. Yes, I do hear how that sounds after a lecture on humility.
lore5491_idle_1.ogg.text: I remember the count of my best throw. Entirely. Yes, I do hear how that sounds after a lecture on humility.

lore5491_learned_1.ogg.spoken: [firm encouragement, proud but measured, thoughtful] Well done. Remember the people who helped you reach this point. There will be another learner who could use the same kindness.
lore5491_learned_1.ogg.text: Well done. Remember the people who helped you reach this point. There will be another learner who could use the same kindness.

lore5564_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere affection, reserved warmth, welcoming] You keep finding your way back. That means something to me. Come along, my friend. Let's see a little of the world.
lore5564_befriended_1.ogg.text: You keep finding your way back. That means something to me. Come along, my friend. Let's see a little of the world.

lore5564_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [gruff warmth, amused, quietly eager] An outing? Good. Let me get the walking bag. And remind me to put something edible in it this time.
lore5564_greet_1.ogg.text: An outing? Good. Let me get the walking bag. And remind me to put something edible in it this time.

lore5564_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [self-deprecating, practical, fond humor] More repair thread than lunch. Again. I keep thinking someone will need a seam fixed. Perhaps we should find a baker first.
lore5564_idle_1.ogg.text: More repair thread than lunch. Again. I keep thinking someone will need a seam fixed. Perhaps we should find a baker first.

lore5564_learned_1.ogg.spoken: [quiet pride, encouraging, warmly approving] There. You stayed with it, and now you can do it. Remember that next time the work seems slow.
lore5564_learned_1.ogg.text: There. You stayed with it, and now you can do it. Remember that next time the work seems slow.

lore6171_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [reserved affection, pleased, warmly inviting] You came to bring me along. I am glad of your friendship. Come. Today there is time for us to share a little of the road ourselves.
lore6171_befriended_1.ogg.text: You came to bring me along. I am glad of your friendship. Come. Today there is time for us to share a little of the road ourselves.

lore6171_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [measured authority, sincere interest, welcoming warmth] Welcome, my friend. A walk would be good. Tell me what has occupied you. I should like to hear about the people, as well as the challenges.
lore6171_greet_1.ogg.text: Welcome, my friend. A walk would be good. Tell me what has occupied you. I should like to hear about the people, as well as the challenges.

lore6171_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [reflective gravity, restrained affection, thoughtful] Before I send a pupil away, I think of the people who will be glad to see them return. A familiar instruction must never become an empty speech. There is a life going out through that door.
lore6171_idle_1.ogg.text: Before I send a pupil away, I think of the people who will be glad to see them return. A familiar instruction must never become an empty speech. There is a life going out through that door.

lore6171_learned_1.ogg.spoken: [firm encouragement, approving, purposeful warmth] Well done. Now consider whom this new ability may help. Be proud of what you have learned, and take care in how you use it.
lore6171_learned_1.ogg.text: Well done. Now consider whom this new ability may help. Be proud of what you have learned, and take care in how you use it.

lore6175_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [moved, warm, restrained gratitude] You remember to ask after me, too. That kindness means more than I know how to say.
lore6175_befriended_1.ogg.text: You remember to ask after me, too. That kindness means more than I know how to say.

lore6175_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [gentle, a little tired, warmly grateful] A little company would be welcome. Thank you for thinking to ask.
lore6175_greet_1.ogg.text: A little company would be welcome. Thank you for thinking to ask.

lore6175_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [fond, hopeful, quiet sincerity] Stephanie should hear about the kind people here, as well as the bundles coming home.
lore6175_idle_1.ogg.text: Stephanie should hear about the kind people here, as well as the bundles coming home.

lore6175_mail_1.ogg.spoken: [hopeful warmth, homesick affection] A letter? I hope there's news from Stephanie. It's good to hear an ordinary day went well.
lore6175_mail_1.ogg.text: A letter? I hope there's news from Stephanie. It's good to hear an ordinary day went well.

lore66_bagsFull_1.ogg.spoken: [calm, helpful voice, practical reassurance] Let's bundle the little things together. There may be room yet.
lore66_bagsFull_1.ogg.text: Let's bundle the little things together. There may be room yet.

lore66_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincerely appreciative voice, gentle pride] You stop to tell me what you've made. That's my favorite part of the trade.
lore66_befriended_1.ogg.text: You stop to tell me what you've made. That's my favorite part of the trade.

lore66_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [genial, practical voice, cheerful readiness] Off we go, then. You've got the tools, and I've got spare string.
lore66_greet_1.ogg.text: Off we go, then. You've got the tools, and I've got spare string.

lore66_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [warm, quietly pleased voice] A neat knot makes a small thing feel worth opening carefully.
lore66_idle_1.ogg.text: A neat knot makes a small thing feel worth opening carefully.

lore74_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [warm, relieved voice, sincere affection] It's nice having a friend I don't have to look impressive for.
lore74_befriended_1.ogg.text: It's nice having a friend I don't have to look impressive for.

lore74_gear_1.ogg.spoken: [calm, attentive voice, encouraging patience] Try a few steps. Good clothes ought to let you forget you're wearing them.
lore74_gear_1.ogg.text: Try a few steps. Good clothes ought to let you forget you're wearing them.

lore74_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [friendly voice, lightly embarrassed amusement] A walk? Certainly. Just give me a moment to find the sensible shoes.
lore74_greet_1.ogg.text: A walk? Certainly. Just give me a moment to find the sensible shoes.

lore74_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [dry, playful voice, mock dignity] Those slippers are a serious study in comfort. A very pleasant study.
lore74_idle_1.ogg.text: Those slippers are a serious study in comfort. A very pleasant study.

lore7798_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere affection, pleased, inviting] You came to bring me along. I am glad of your friendship. Come on. Today we can share a little of the road ourselves.
lore7798_befriended_1.ogg.text: You came to bring me along. I am glad of your friendship. Come on. Today we can share a little of the road ourselves.

lore7798_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [confident warmth, interested, welcoming] There you are, my friend. Shall we go out? I should like to hear what you have been doing with all that determination.
lore7798_greet_1.ogg.text: There you are, my friend. Shall we go out? I should like to hear what you have been doing with all that determination.

lore7798_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [reflective pride, sincere warmth, hopeful] I like to imagine a pupil teaching someone I shall never meet. Galvan's old promise, still on the road. That is a good thought to carry into the work.
lore7798_idle_1.ogg.text: I like to imagine a pupil teaching someone I shall never meet. Galvan's old promise, still on the road. That is a good thought to carry into the work.

lore7798_learned_1.ogg.spoken: [firm encouragement, proud, generous warmth] Well done. Keep the lesson, and when someone else is ready to learn it, give them the same chance. That is work worth being proud of.
lore7798_learned_1.ogg.text: Well done. Keep the lesson, and when someone else is ready to learn it, give them the same chance. That is work worth being proud of.

lore7917_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere affection, grateful warmth] A place beside you for a while. Thank you, my friend. I'm glad a welcome can lead to company like this.
lore7917_befriended_1.ogg.text: A place beside you for a while. Thank you, my friend. I'm glad a welcome can lead to company like this.

lore7917_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [warm delight, welcoming, gently amused] Welcome, my friend! Oh, we're going out? How lovely. You'll have to show me where we're headed.
lore7917_greet_1.ogg.text: Welcome, my friend! Oh, we're going out? How lovely. You'll have to show me where we're headed.

lore7917_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [grateful, quietly delighted, affectionate] A welcome back to me. Such a small thing, and it can brighten the whole afternoon. You'd think I'd be used to it by now.
lore7917_idle_1.ogg.text: A welcome back to me. Such a small thing, and it can brighten the whole afternoon. You'd think I'd be used to it by now.

lore7917_quest_1.ogg.spoken: [warm approval, sincere, quietly encouraging] You saw someone who needed help, and you answered. I'm very glad. There is kindness in seeing a thing through.
lore7917_quest_1.ogg.text: You saw someone who needed help, and you answered. I'm very glad. There is kindness in seeing a thing through.

lore8670_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere warmth, relaxed, grateful] I spend all day making myself heard. It's good to be with someone I can simply talk to. Thank you for coming.
lore8670_befriended_1.ogg.text: I spend all day making myself heard. It's good to be with someone I can simply talk to. Thank you for coming.

lore8670_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [booming announcer at first, then sheepish chuckle, friendly] YOUR ATTENTION, PLEASE! Ah. Yours will do nicely. Sorry. A walk sounds splendid.
lore8670_greet_1.ogg.text: YOUR ATTENTION, PLEASE! Ah. Yours will do nicely. Sorry. A walk sounds splendid.

lore8670_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [confiding, dry humor, deliberately conversational] I practice a quiet hello. Occupational habit. You'd be surprised how easily a friendly visit becomes a public announcement.
lore8670_idle_1.ogg.text: I practice a quiet hello. Occupational habit. You'd be surprised how easily a friendly visit becomes a public announcement.

lore8670_mail_1.ogg.spoken: [curious, amused, playfully restrained] News from the auctions? Go on, have a look. I can wait without announcing the contents to the street.
lore8670_mail_1.ogg.text: News from the auctions? Go on, have a look. I can wait without announcing the contents to the street.

lore8719_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere, welcoming, gently affectionate] A visit without a transaction. I like that. I hope you'll keep coming back, even when you've nothing to list.
lore8719_befriended_1.ogg.text: A visit without a transaction. I like that. I hope you'll keep coming back, even when you've nothing to list.

lore8719_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [polite, easy warmth, quietly pleased] Good to see you. No need to buy anything. Shall we have a look around together?
lore8719_greet_1.ogg.text: Good to see you. No need to buy anything. Shall we have a look around together?

lore8719_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [trying to sound casual, sheepish amusement, fond] What sorts of little things do you like? No particular reason. That sounded much less suspicious in my head.
lore8719_idle_1.ogg.text: What sorts of little things do you like? No particular reason. That sounded much less suspicious in my head.

lore8719_loot_1.ogg.spoken: [thoughtful, helpful, curious] That looks interesting. Before we put a price on it, do you want to keep it for yourself?
lore8719_loot_1.ogg.text: That looks interesting. Before we put a price on it, do you want to keep it for yourself?

lore894_bagsFull_1.ogg.spoken: [practical, amused voice, kindly instruction] Heavy things at the bottom, fruit at the top. There, your lunch has a chance now.
lore894_bagsFull_1.ogg.text: Heavy things at the bottom, fruit at the top. There, your lunch has a chance now.

lore894_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [warm, pleased voice, personal affection] I know which one you'd reach for now. That's a nice thing to know about someone.
lore894_befriended_1.ogg.text: I know which one you'd reach for now. That's a nice thing to know about someone.

lore894_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [open, cheerful voice, friendly invitation] Good to see you! Pick something for the road before we leave.
lore894_greet_1.ogg.text: Good to see you! Pick something for the road before we leave.

lore894_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [genial, thoughtful voice, easy amusement] A crooked apple can still be sweet. Worth remembering when you're choosing.
lore894_idle_1.ogg.text: A crooked apple can still be sweet. Worth remembering when you're choosing.

lore918_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [reserved affection, pleased, inviting] You came to bring me along. I am glad, my friend. Come on. A little company with no message to deliver will be welcome.
lore918_befriended_1.ogg.text: You came to bring me along. I am glad, my friend. Come on. A little company with no message to deliver will be welcome.

lore918_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [low-key warmth, knowing amusement, welcoming] There you are, my friend. Shall we take a walk? Keep an ear open. There is a tune I should like you to hear, if someone happens to be playing it today.
